text: Greetings to you all. There is a distinction between positive matters and the "prosperity message"—and I am not against the prosperity message, naturally. However, in our daily lives, as we meet many people, we often encounter a great deal of negativity. Because of this prevalence of negative things, we often feel drained or depleted in our spirits. Hallelujah. I hope you are all doing well; that is very important. That is why I ask after you—I consider it a great privilege not only to share God's word but also to inquire about your well-being, to comfort you, and to bring you solace. The Lord is good; it is a great privilege. In this day and age, few people truly care to ask after others. So, are you doing well? Do not worry about anything. The Lord will surely lead us today.

There was a mother who used to come and see me regularly—every Thursday, without fail. I once asked her, "Mother, why do you arrive so late? You really ought to come a bit earlier." She replied, "Please don't take this the wrong way, Sir, but I have never seen Jesus in the flesh; I have only seen you. If I were to come earlier, I would end up looking at all sorts of other people. But when I look at your face—that one minute where you ask after me, that smile, that warmth and love you show—it sustains me throughout the entire week." Her words amazed me.

I said, "I am doing well," though he hadn't actually noticed me; that was simply his style—the style of that country. America has changed now; nowadays, there is more selfishness, and such greetings are rare. Yet, that incident left a lasting impression on my mind...Had I known them before?
